question.problem: Estimate the area under the curve $y=-{x}^{2}+2x$ over the interval $[0,2]$ using a right Riemann sum with step size $Δx=0.5.$
question.worked_solution:
Let's sketch our situation.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14222967/assets/0b9dd2388a7b60866eb15d336d51d181853fe5ac0e52dcd3e02f53fdd4848532.png)

The area $A$ under the graph can be approximated using the formula

$$
A≈(\overset{\text{heights}}{\overset{⏞}{f(0.5)+f(1)+f(1.5)+f(2)}})\cdot {{Δx}_{⏟}}_{\text{width}}.
$$

So, we now set up a table with the values of $f(x)$ at each point:

| $x$ | $0.5$ | $1$ | $1.5$ | $2$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $0.75$ | $1$ | $0.75$ | $0$ |

Finally, we obtain the following approximation for our area:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & ≈(0.75+1+0.75+0)\cdot 0.5 \\  & =2.5\cdot 0.5 \\  & =1.25\end{aligned}
$$
